_meta.title: Restaurant Recommendation Agent — First-Pass Domain Ontology (v1)
purpose: Tag ingested facts + RAG chunks with concept labels (concept-driven retrieval instead of pure vector similarity)
Ground the abductive reasoning step (hypothesis generation + evidence evaluation)
Provide a structure that can be rendered as a diagram for RQ2 (agent explaining its own reasoning)
_meta.scope_note: Intentionally small (dozens of concepts, not hundreds). Expand only when a concept is needed to explain an actual data field or support an actual hypothesis type below.

Restaurant.description: A single dining establishment in the SLC dataset.

RestaurantGroup.description: A parent entity or informal group linking sibling restaurants (shared ownership, brand, or registered agent).

CuisineType.description: Hierarchical cuisine taxonomy (normalize OSM/Foursquare tags into this).

PriceTier.description: Coarse price bucket, normalized from $ / $$ / $$$ / $$$$ tags.

Inspection.description: A single health inspection event for a restaurant.

ViolationType.description: Normalized category of health code violation (map raw SLCHD violation codes into these buckets so they're reasoning-tractable, not just free text).

ReviewTheme.description: Normalized theme bucket for sentiment/review content (assign via classification when ingesting review/Reddit/news text, or via RAG-retrieved chunk tagging).

SentimentTrend.description: Direction of sentiment for a restaurant over a time window.

MarketingSignal.description: A recognition/marketing event tied to a restaurant.

Hypothesis.description: A candidate explanation the agent generates when answering a recommendation query. This is the abductive-reasoning unit — the agent should generate several of these per query, then evaluate each against available evidence rather than emitting one answer directly.

Evidence.description: A single fact or retrieved chunk cited in support of or against a Hypothesis. Every Evidence instance must be traceable to a concrete source — this is what makes RQ2 (agent explaining itself) answerable rather than hand-wavy.

relations.name: correlatesWithReviewTheme
relations.note: e.g. temperature_control violations often co-occur with food_quality complaints

relations.name: locatedNear
relations.note: spatial proximity, for area-based recommendation queries

hypothesis_evidence_map._note: This is the 'analytical guidance' layer: a starting map of which concept types are relevant evidence for which hypothesis type. The agent uses this to know WHERE to look (which tool / which RAG tag) when evaluating a given hypothesis, rather than searching everything unguided.

look_for: Inspection.violations: none, or only non_critical, stable over time
Inspection.violations: recent increase in count or severity
ReviewTheme: mixed or declining sentiment despite marketing presence
ReviewTheme: high variance across food_quality / service / wait_time

example.selection_note: Selection = highest confidence given evidence balance; the agent's explanation to the user should walk through h1 vs h2 and why h1 won. This h1-vs-h2 comparison is exactly what your diagram/report should render.
